name: web_search
description:
Search the web for current information using OpenAI's web search capability.

Returns real-time search results with URLs, titles, and citations.
Use this tool when you need up-to-date information beyond your training data.

Examples:
- "What is the current weather in New York?"
- "Latest news about AI regulations"
- "Current stock price of AAPL"

The search is powered by GPT and returns cited, fact-checked results.

allowed_domains.description: Only include results from these domains (e.g., ['wikipedia.org', 'github.com']). Cannot be used with blocked_domains. Max 100 domains.

blocked_domains.description: Exclude results from these domains. Cannot be used with allowed_domains.

user_location.description: Approximate user location for geo-relevant results
